qte_sweep._doc: Per-phase timing QTE (Austin approved 2026-11-11 10:56 PM PT; sim pin f0efecf). One sweep each during playback (shots11, Austin 2026-11-12): the cars hold at the Entry / Apex / Exit point while that phase's timer (lead + base zone + tail, at least result_hold_s after the score) runs, the road keeps scrolling, then they drive on. Zone width = qte_zone_width(r, qte_window_mod) x QTE_ZONE_BASE_MS (sim equations.py:346 / :133), the same for all three. Score of a press = max(0, 1 - |e| / (zone/2)), e = press time - zone centre (equations.py:280 docstring). The cursor passing the zone's far edge = unplayed = 0 (Barry's sim; Austin: unplayed scores 0). Every number below is a PLACEHOLDER (display only, never read by the sim).
qte_sweep._lead_ms: PLACEHOLDER: cursor travel before it reaches the zone's near edge
qte_sweep._tail_ms: PLACEHOLDER: bar drawn past a full-width zone (visual only; the sweep ends at the zone's far edge)
qte_sweep._ready_s: UNUSED since shots11 (the QTEs moved into playback); was the beat after LINE LOCKED before the Entry sweep
qte_sweep._result_hold_s: PLACEHOLDER: minimum time a phase's score stays up before the cars drive on
qte_sweep._key: PLACEHOLDER: kept from the earlier timing needle

playback_flow._doc: shots9 (Austin playtest 2026-11-11 ~9:58-10:01 PM PT). Display/flow only, never read by the sim. EVERY NUMBER HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER awaiting Desmond/Austin.
playback_flow._continue_s: PLACEHOLDER: after-turn pause ('Press Enter to continue', visible countdown, auto-continues). Starts once the RESULT row has filled in. Austin: 'That should have a time limit.' No pause in line selection or playback (B.5a).

playback_flow._blend: PLACEHOLDER: the car leaves its Entry lane this many m before turn-in, reaches its Apex lane at mid-arc, and its Exit lane this many m past the arc
playback_flow._pass_u: UNUSED since shots12 (Austin 2026-11-12: order only changes after the Exit QTE). Was the part of playback (0..1) over which the visual gap moved from the pre-turn to the post-turn value.
playback_flow._pass_after_exit_s: PLACEHOLDER: after the Exit QTE finishes (qte_i >= 3), the visual gap moves from the pre-turn value (off0) to the post-turn value (off1, from the same Combat.resolve_turn the core uses) over this many seconds. Remaining playback after the Exit hold is only ~0.16 s (HP) / ~0.23 s (N90) of disp.playback_s, too short to read a pass, so the animation continues into the RESULT / Enter-to-continue phase. 2.5 s matches the old readable window (pass_u1-pass_u0)*playback_s = 2.52 s. Cars stay on the playback path (s_player still caps at the end of playback) so the Exit camera is unchanged; the planned fixed hold-after-exit camera is not built yet.
playback_flow._overlap: PLACEHOLDER: the passer is fully in the open lane while the cars are within 5.5 m along the road, back on its line beyond 9 m (= visual_gap.min_spacing_m)
playback_flow._min_sep_m: PLACEHOLDER: lines closer than this while overlapping count as a shared lane
playback_flow._car_len_m: no-clip check: lateral gap is measured while the cars are within this many m along the road
